INSERT INTO recommend (summary_id, product_id, rank_no, score, created_at) VALUES
(#{summaryId}, #{it.productId}, #{it.rank}, #{it.score}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.product_id AS productId, r.rank_no AS rankNo, r.score, p.name AS name, p.price, p.img, p.link, c.category_id AS categoryId FROM recommend r JOIN product p ON r.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE r.summary_id = #{summaryId} ORDER BY r.rank_no ASC
